title: Wallet
description: User digital wallet single source of truth at wallets/{userId}. Transaction history stored in subcollection wallets/{userId}/transactions/{txId}

id.description: Wallet ID matching users.id (e.g. USR-101 or WRK-201)

balance.description: Available balance in INR for convenience

pendingWithdrawalsPaise.description: Amount locked in pending withdrawal requests in paise
